common: Use case: precise-object-edit / production-layer isolation. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: our ONE AUTHORITATIVE full-body monkey master. Isolate ONE layer from this exact master, keeping identical art style, visible details, orientation, scale and ORIGINAL ABSOLUTE PIXEL POSITION on the same 1024x1536 canvas. DO NOT enlarge, recenter, rotate or redesign the part. All other pixels become fully transparent. This is not a new independent object drawing. Return a full 1024x1536 genuine RGBA PNG, mostly empty transparent space, with ONLY the specified part at the specified master coordinates. No labels, diagram, frame, background, shadow, halo or RGB wash showing through alpha. Opaque paint inside shape; clean narrow antialiased outline. No stray fragments. Concealed anatomy must be fully painted, connected and overlapped; hidden overlap caps have no black transverse seam. Target layer:

layers.arm_l_upper: ONLY SCREEN-LEFT UPPER ARM, the far-side wine red jacket sleeve from screen-left shoulder near (334,548) to elbow near (164,667). Approximate artwork bounds x=125..362,y=510..708. Retain this exact sloping-down-left pose and sleeve silhouette. Remove ALL torso, head, forearm, white cuff and hand, no other arm. Underpaint complete hidden shoulder end extending 20 pixels into shoulder socket and rounded elbow end extending 20 pixels into lower-arm joint. Hidden overlap caps have NO black crosswise line and stay inside natural sleeve width. One connected tapering upper-arm sleeve, not circles or lumps.
